ci.evidence: Completed job logs inspected. Windows covers the Python media pipeline, not batch packaging. The final report commit changes only this execution record.

limitations: Synthetic tests are technical evidence only. Imported/generated ASR remains raw.
Evidence hashes do not authenticate semantic observations or human receipts.
Preview renderer rejects unsupported EDL treatments and does not implement loudness targets.
resolved_failures: FFprobe bounded decoding initially omitted a delayed B-frame; decode margin added before timestamp filtering.
concat output initially lacked the last frame duration; declare proven native CFR to preserve frame count and average FPS.
Renderer accessed optional assets/ducking fields directly; added absent-field regression and schema-compatible defaults.
Windows FFmpeg 9.0.2 removed filter_complex_script; replaced with a single filter_complex argv argument and portable length limit.
Windows checkout changed legacy example line endings; added repository LF attributes so original JSON bytes remain reproducible.

windows.reason: Initial run failed on removed filter_complex_script flag and CRLF fixture conversion. Both corrected and regression passed in fcd9a6c.

before_after.before: Word-level ASR JSON needed manual reshaping and could lose untimed tokens.
before_after.after: Importer retains ASR_RAW text, source offsets, anonymous speakers, raw hashes and unresolved alignment/text gaps.

before_after.before: Source evidence was checked only as declarations.
before_after.after: Inspection bundles create actual source derivatives; integrity check verifies original metadata/hash and generated file hashes. Semantic truth still requires review.

before_after.before: EDL decisions had no general execution path beyond a fixed smoke command.
before_after.after: A bounded renderer executes cuts, crops, fixed-size pans and verified static dialogue, validates output and refuses unsupported decisions.
91 tests including real FFmpeg media execution pass on Windows FFmpeg 9.0.2 and Ubuntu FFmpeg 6.1.1.
